transcript.text: I need to flag an important issue before we finalize this. In reviewing Northstar Health's prior coexistence settlement with another mark owner, I confirmed two things: First, Northstar is already bound to keep its similar mark out of U.S. brick-and-mortar retail but may use it in U.S. online marketplaces under that agreement. Second, that settlement includes an annual quality-control audit right for the other party. I have not yet incorporated either of these restrictions into our current draft, and they directly affect our open terms — particularly the permitted territory and quality-control rights.
